lines.en: My friend is busy on Saturday.
I pick up her son for her.
We take the bus. It's packed!
We go to a hawker centre.
"Is this seat taken?" I ask an auntie.
lines.zh: "这个位子有人吗？"我问一位阿姨。

lines.en: The auntie is very funny.
He is thirsty. We get a drink.
He fell down and cut his knee.
"Don't cry. Don't be scared."
I have a plaster in my bag.
We wash our hands and go to the playground.
lines.zh: 我们洗了手，去游乐场玩。

lines.en: Later, my friend is here.

dialogue.title: 舅舅来接他
dialogue.setting: 下午，林太太的儿子在补习中心摔了一跤。Amy 先打电话给林太太，后来孩子的舅舅来接他。舅舅说话很有新加坡味道。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Hello, Mrs Lim. This is Amy from the learning centre.
lines.zh: 您好，林太太。我是补习中心的 Amy。

lines.speaker: Mrs Lim
lines.en: Hi Amy. Is my son OK?
lines.zh: 你好 Amy。我儿子没事吧？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: He fell down and hurt his knee.

lines.speaker: Mrs Lim
lines.en: Is he OK?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Don't worry, he is OK now. He has a plaster.
lines.zh: 别担心，他现在没事了，已经贴了创可贴。

lines.speaker: Mrs Lim
lines.en: Thank you. His uncle will pick him up.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: OK. Please call us if he is late.
lines.zh: 好的。如果他会晚到，请给我们打电话。

lines.speaker: Uncle
lines.en: Hi! Mrs Lim called me. Can I pick up her son?
lines.zh: 你好！林太太给我打了电话。我来接她儿子，可以吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes. He is waiting at the front desk.

lines.speaker: Uncle
lines.en: His knee OK or not?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes, he is OK now. Don't worry.
lines.zh: 没事，他现在好了。别担心。

lines.speaker: Uncle
lines.en: OK, can! Thank you.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: No problem. Be careful on the road!

lines.speaker: Uncle
lines.en: OK, see you later!
